sources.fact: Historic LBBD42 Beam Park Brownfield entry recorded 20.09ha, maximum 2,900 dwellings and pending-decision status, with an end date of 20 February 2025.
The older Brownfield record is not allowed to override later exact planning decisions and 2025-2026 phase evidence.
22/01048/OUTSRM remastered the LBBD part of Beam Park and proposed an uplift of 947 dwellings to a total of 3,119 units, with 50% affordable by unit.
The 3,119-unit figure is the remastered LBBD development scope and is not added on top of the historic 2,900 figure.
25/01203/REM is the Phase B reserved-matters application for 405 dwellings under 22/01048/OUTSRM.
Phase B was reported with 51% affordable and 33% family-sized units; these percentages remain phase-specific.
The 405 Phase B homes are not added to 3,119 as extra masterplan capacity because they sit within the approved outline envelope.
March 2026 committee material records Condition 71 tying development outside Phases A-D to construction and passenger availability of Beam Park Station.
Station-condition amendments are delivery/phasing evidence and are not converted into proof that the station is operational or that later phases are unrestricted.
February 2026 Cabinet approved in-principle lease/disposal arrangements for Beam Park addresses as part of a combined 854-home Beam Park + Gascoigne East Phase 3B package.
The combined 854-home figure is not interpreted as 854 Beam Park homes alone.
Named 2026 Beam Park addresses provide concrete new-build lease/delivery evidence but do not establish whole-masterplan completion or exact HMLR parcel relations.

examples.result: Historic 2,900 pending-decision Brownfield status is treated as stale context after its 2025 end date.
3,119 is the remastered total and is not added to 2,900.
Phase B 405 homes sit within the 3,119 envelope and are not extra capacity.
Phase B affordable/family percentages are not extrapolated site-wide.
Station Condition 71 is retained as a phasing dependency, not proof of station operation.
The 2026 combined 854 figure is not assigned entirely to Beam Park.
Named lease addresses are partial delivery assets, not whole-site completion or title bindings.
Promotion remains zero until exact canonical parcel/title relation and executed statutory overlays are verified.
